name: Sustained basis carry harvest — hold spot while the term premium persists (long)
rationale: TERM-STRUCTURE / CARRY, the harvest side that the existing basis specs (both CONTRARIAN reversion plays) never build. perp_spot_basis is the perp-spot price spread = the market's revealed price of leverage / term premium. A SUSTAINED moderate-positive basis means the futures curve is in steady contango: longs persistently value the leverage, a structurally-bid carry regime. Rather than fade an EXTREME (the contrarian specs), this HARVESTS the persistence: long spot while a moderate-positive basis holds (not so extreme it is a blow-off, gated by an upper guard via the symmetric between exit), and exit only when the basis decays back toward zero (carry exhausted). Mechanism before data: enter when basis is above a fitted carry floor AND a slow trend confirms the regime is intact; the signal exit fires when basis falls below a decay level. Distinct from perp-basis-discount-contrarian-long-spot (basis EXTREME-LOW reversion) and g2-basis-funding-orthogonal-carry-long (basis + a FUNDING orthogonality gate) — this is a pure single-axis term-carry persistence play with no funding arm. Disconfirmer 1: a plain unconditional spot long over the same sample/costs must not match the deflated Sharpe — the basis floor must add timing. Disconfirmer 2: if the edge is identical whether basis is moderate OR extreme, it is just a long-bias proxy, not a carry-persistence read. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): basis is small (~1e-3 scale here); net of ~20bps the carry-plus-drift must clear or it is fee-dead. tier0 perp_spot_basis + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: a sustained moderate-positive perp_spot_basis (steady contango / term carry) with a confirming slow trend — harvested by holding spot
